t: You're looking at the Ritz London, the five-star hotel at 150 Piccadilly. It is so closely tied to luxury that the word ritzy has entered the English language. The architects Charles Mewès and Arthur Joseph Davis designed it. Two notable people are linked to the building in a more personal way. Robin Russell, later the fourteenth Duke of Bedford, was born here. And Margaret Thatcher, Britain's longest-serving prime minister of the twentieth century and the first woman to hold the office, died here in 2013.
